core: Epithelial–mesenchymal signaling in branching organ morphogenesis
qualifier: salivary gland and pancreatic lineages
name: Epithelial–mesenchymal signaling in salivary and pancreatic morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern reciprocal epithelial–mesenchymal signaling, epithelial branching and maturation in developing glands (salivary branching, pancreatic ductal/endocrine lineages, kidney, limb bud), whereas confusables centre on lung, mammary/prostate or metanephric kidney development.

qualifier: positive regulation via VEGF production and signaling
name: Positive regulation of VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: All members promote endothelial sprouting, proliferation, migration or branching, including VEGF production and VEGFR signaling, while confusables carry negative regulation, Tie2 or endothelial activation terms.

qualifier: estrogen and progesterone receptors
name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: Members describe cellular responses to estrogen/estradiol, estrogen-dependent gene expression and progesterone receptor signaling, distinguishing the theme from androgen-receptor and mammary-development confusables.

qualifier: lipoproteins and immune complexes
name: Scavenger receptor–mediated clearance of lipoproteins and immune complexes
rationale: Members are scavenging by class A, B, F and H receptors plus immune complex clearance, cholesterol storage and protein import, whereas confusables emphasise apoptotic cell clearance, hyaluronan or iron/heme uptake.

qualifier: POMT/POMGNT1 dystroglycanopathy defects
name: Alpha-dystroglycan O-mannosylation and dystroglycanopathy defects
rationale: All members are DAG1 core M1–M3 glycosylations or POMT1/POMT2/POMGNT1 defects causing muscular dystrophy-dystroglycanopathies, unlike confusables on the dystrophin complex, muscle or GDP-mannose/CDG biosynthesis.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and TKI resistance
qualifier: KIT and PDGFR
name: Oncogenic KIT and PDGFR mutants and TKI resistance
rationale: Members are KIT and PDGFR mutant signaling and drug-resistant variants to imatinib, sunitinib and other TKIs, whereas confusables cover FLT3, ALK and FGFR mutants and fusions.

qualifier: urogenital: micturition, copulation, parturition
name: Urogenital smooth muscle function in micturition, copulation and parturition
rationale: Members are urinary, uterine and penile contractile/visceral motor events (micturition, parturition, erection, insemination, peristalsis), unlike confusables on GI motility, smooth muscle relaxation, tachykinin signaling or social behaviour.

core: Epithelial–mesenchymal signaling in branching organ development
qualifier: mesenchymal proliferation in lung and salivary gland
name: Mesenchymal proliferation and epithelial–mesenchymal signaling in lung and salivary development
rationale: Members combine epithelial–mesenchymal crosstalk with regulation of mesenchymal proliferation and lung-associated mesenchyme and salivary branching, whereas confusables focus on prostate, pancreas/kidney or lung epithelial branching.

qualifier: misfolded protein quality control and ERAD
name: Atypical polyubiquitin chain formation in misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members are K6/K11/K27/K29-linked, branched and free ubiquitin chain synthesis together with misfolded-protein quality control, ERAD and Josephin DUBs, while confusables centre on E1/E2 and other DUBs, proteasomal degradation or ER stress responses.

core: Canonical Wnt, Notch and Hedgehog signal transduction
qualifier: including oncogenic pathway mutants
name: Canonical Wnt, Notch and Hedgehog signaling including oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members cover beta-catenin destruction complex and TCF signaling, Notch receptor processing and NICD transcription, and GLI/SMO Hedgehog signaling with their cancer mutants, unlike confusables on Hh ligand lipidation, Hippo, Wnt secretion or planar cell polarity.

qualifier: ketone body synthesis and utilization
name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members are the stepwise beta-oxidation of acyl-CoAs from palmitoyl to acetyl-CoA plus ketone body synthesis and utilization, whereas confusables cover the carnitine shuttle, peroxisomal steps or branched-chain amino acid/PDH metabolism.

qualifier: aspirin, atorvastatin, ciprofloxacin, prednisone
name: Pharmacokinetics of aspirin, atorvastatin, ciprofloxacin and prednisone
rationale: All four members are ADME of specific therapeutic drugs, distinguished from confusables on paracetamol/conjugation, general xenobiotic metabolism or SLC transport.

qualifier: histamine response plus serotonin synthesis and uptake
name: Histamine signaling and serotonin synthesis, uptake and secretion
rationale: Members are histamine receptors/metabolism and serotonin biosynthesis, transport and secretion, unlike confusables on monoamine oxidative degradation, catecholamines or serotonin receptor signaling.

qualifier: endothelial shear stress mechanotransduction and smooth muscle development
name: Endothelial shear stress sensing and vascular smooth muscle development
rationale: Members combine endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory flow (PIEZO1) with vascular smooth muscle development, matrix adhesion and perivascular/endothelial modules, while confusables cover eNOS trafficking, VSMC phenotypic switching or SRF targets.

qualifier: glycosaminoglycans and glycosphingolipids with storage disorders
name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan and glycosphingolipid degradation and storage disorders
rationale: Members are degradation of HS, CS/DS, keratan sulfate and gangliosides and the mucopolysaccharidoses, GM2 gangliosidoses and sialidosis, unlike confusables on sialic acid metabolism, GAG biosynthesis or general lysosome terms.

core: Viral replication cycle in host cells
qualifier: attachment, entry, protein maturation and assembly
name: Viral attachment, entry, protein maturation and assembly
rationale: Members span receptor-mediated entry, viral protein maturation and virion assembly for coronaviruses, dengue, influenza, RSV and HIV, whereas confusables lack entry or maturation steps or concern host restriction of viruses.

qualifier: hereditary spastic paraplegia and adrenoleukodystrophy defects
name: Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation and hereditary spastic paraplegia defects
rationale: Members are acyl-CoA oxidase, very-long-chain and pristanoyl-CoA beta-oxidation plus ALD and spastic paraplegia gene defects, while confusables emphasise peroxisome biogenesis, protein import or alpha-oxidation.

qualifier: SALMs and receptor tyrosine phosphatases
name: Synapse assembly via SALM and receptor tyrosine phosphatase adhesion
rationale: Members concern synaptic membrane adhesion and trans-synaptic complexes organizing pre- and postsynaptic assembly, distinguished by SALMs and RPTPs from confusables built on neurexin–neuroligin and NMDA/PSD-95 clustering.

qualifier: blood gas and Rh ammonium transport
name: Erythroid heme and iron metabolism with blood gas transport
rationale: Members span heme biosynthesis, iron uptake and homeostasis defects, erythrocyte differentiation, O2/CO2/NO transport and Rh ammonium transport, whereas confusables cover other metal ions, oxidative stress or pathogen iron handling.

qualifier: amino acid, monoamine and cholinergic transmitters
name: Neurotransmitter synthesis, vesicular release, reuptake and degradation
rationale: Members cover synthesis, vesicle loading, clostridial-toxin-sensitive release, SLC reuptake and catabolism of GABA, glutamate, glycine, monoamines and acetylcholine, unlike confusables limited to catecholaminergic development, dopamine receptor behaviour or cholinergic NMJ transmission.

qualifier: phosphatidylserine-mediated recognition
name: Phosphatidylserine-mediated recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells
rationale: All four members describe efferocytosis steps (PS exposure, recognition, engulfment, neutrophil clearance), unlike confusables on microglial activation or scavenger receptors.

qualifier: glucagon, ghrelin and nutrient-metabolite receptors
name: Glucagon, ghrelin and nutrient-metabolite GPCR signaling
rationale: Members are GPCR-mediated metabolic hormone and nutrient sensing (glucagon, ghrelin, somatostatin, free fatty acid and hydroxycarboxylic acid receptors, adenylate cyclase activation), unlike confusables on feeding behaviour, leptin or calcitonin/amylin receptors.

qualifier: HDAC/NCoR corepressor function and Rett mutations
name: MECP2 and HDAC-mediated neuronal gene repression and Rett mutations
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation of neuronal genes and its Rett loss-of-function variants with HDAC deacetylation, NPAS4 and memory, distinguished from confusables on behaviour, MECP2–GABA genes or CREB/cAMP signaling.

qualifier: Pol I/III rRNA and small RNA transcription plus splicing
name: Nuclear transcription and processing of rRNA, small RNAs and pre-mRNA
rationale: Members span Pol I and Pol III transcription, pre-rRNA processing, snRNA/snRNP biogenesis, splicing, histone mRNA 3' processing and nuclear RNA decay, whereas confusables concern mRNA export, rRNA modification or cytoplasmic translation initiation.

qualifier: maternal mRNA decay and zygotic genome activation
name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition with maternal mRNA decay and genome activation
rationale: Members cover oocyte construction, maternal mRNA deadenylation and M/Z-decay, zygotic genome activation, cleavage and zygotic epigenetic programming, unlike confusables on germline specification, piRNA silencing or spermatogenesis.
